name: Greywatch Keep
short_role: A compact two-floor fort whose rooms reinforce one another.
question: Which adjacent functions must survive together?

starter_plan.title: Layer the gate road
starter_plan.intent: Put a living melee line behind a deliberate choke so the compact rooms reinforce one readable approach.
starter_plan.tradeoff: The upper wall and distant supply room remain lightly covered.

doctrine_geometry.opening: Join the Gate and Inner Yard into one reinforced contact line.
doctrine_geometry.fit: Layered Masonry compounds Greywatch's compact room edges.

doctrine_geometry.opening: Leave response cells open around the yard and punish enemies crossing them.
doctrine_geometry.fit: Open Lanes turns Greywatch's central yard into a mobile response pocket.
doctrine_geometry.risk: Separated defenders receive less protection from the compact core.

doctrine_geometry.opening: Bank repair capacity beside the Workshop before committing the front line.
doctrine_geometry.fit: Measured Stores pays for Greywatch's expensive deep repairs across three assaults.
doctrine_geometry.risk: The first contact has fewer direct attackers.

doctrine_geometry.opening: Assign precision cover to the upper wall while the gate holds below.
doctrine_geometry.fit: Posted Orders rewards Greywatch's short assignment links and protected specialists.
doctrine_geometry.risk: Standard Cutters can turn those fixed posts into exposed priorities.

recovery_profile.question: Which damaged function is worth a deep repair?
